reviews.text: As a new pool owner, Dennis has provided much needed professional advice and timely help. He is always willing to answer questions that inevitably come up. He is very friendly and honest too. I will be using his services for a long time to come and I will recommend him to friends and family.
reviews.author: Eric Davidson

reviews.text: I've been with Dennis since he first opened his business, years ago. He's absolutely brilliant with water chemistry, and has always done an outstanding job of taking care of our pool. He's trustworthy, and I've never doubted his integrity (and he loves dogs, so he always makes sure to close the gate)! I highly recommend Dennis and Cavalier Pool!
reviews.author: Cindy Campbell

reviews.text: Very knowledgeable, and seems to be the most honest pool guy I’ve found thus far. Had my pool crystal clear quickly and took the time to explain what he was doing - and why. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Deana Stevens

reviews.text: Great service , very professional, gets the job done and very informative. I most definitely would recommend him to anyone looking for pool service.
reviews.author: willie scenterd

data.summary: The Google reviews appear potentially curated or outdated, with only 5 perfect reviews from 4-6 years ago. The Yelp rating of 3.4 with 28 reviews suggests more authentic, mixed customer experiences. Lack of recent reviews and significant platform discrepancy raises questions about current service quality.
fake_signals: All Google reviews are 5-star and very old (4-6 years)
Low review volume on Google (5) vs Yelp (28) suggests possible selective solicitation or platform abandonment
Google reviews lack specific project details and are generic
authentic_signals: Google reviews mention owner's name (Dennis) and specific traits (knowledgeable, honest, loves dogs)
Varied writing styles in Google reviews
Yelp's 3.4 rating with 28 reviews suggests authentic mixed feedback
complaint_patterns: Cannot determine from provided data - only positive Google reviews shown
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant discrepancy between Google (5.0) and Yelp (3.4) ratings. Google has only 5 reviews, all 5-star and 4-6 years old. Yelp has 28 reviews, indicating a more diverse and recent customer base with mixed experiences.
